card.name: Historical narrative text, dates and eras
card.fires_on: Words in history-writing passages, such as a person's life, years inside dates (1855, 1862, 1934), or era names. It also fires on small words that start a sentence about past events.

modes.label: Digits inside years
modes.description: A digit within a past year or year range in a historical account.

modes.label: Past life or era words
modes.description: A noun about the past, such as life or an era name, in history writing.
modes.example: WHITE BORDER ERA (1915-1930) The White<< Border>> Era brought an end to the postcard

modes.label: Sentence-start words in past accounts
modes.description: A small word like The or this opening a sentence in a narrative about past events.
modes.example: In<< this>> speech he coined his famous line

card.writes: It pushes against history-related words like historical and histor-, and slightly toward other continuing words, so it seems to say that the history topic is already established.
card.plain: It lights up in passages telling the story of past people and events, especially on years and era names.
